statement: ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, Metric.ediam (if j < k then Set.Icc ((j : ℝ) / k) (((j : ℝ) + 1) / k) else ∅) ^ a) = (k : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (k : ℝ))) ^ a
proof:
intro a k
have hd : ∀ j : ℕ, Metric.ediam (Set.Icc ((j : ℝ) / k) (((j : ℝ) + 1) / k)) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (k : ℝ)) := by
  intro j
  rw [Real.ediam_Icc]
  congr 1
  ring
calc
  _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (k : ℝ))) ^ a := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hj), hd]
  _ = _ := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
